title: Maintain continuous business operations
goal: The plan names only dependencies, people and credentials the records still show, every duty it created has a future date or evidence it was met, and the resiliency risks carry the ranges the last test supports.

steps.do: Read the plan against the records as they stand now and list every dependency, credential, contact, owner and backup location that has changed or disappeared since it was written.
Roll each duty the plan created forward to its next date, mark the ones already met with their evidence, and add a duty for every new dependency the venture has taken on since the last run.
Rewrite the ranges on the resiliency risks from what the last test and these changes showed, close the ones whose dependency the venture no longer has, and flag any whose review date has passed.
Add each stale part of the plan to the decision it bears on, and raise to the finance lead whether the plan is worth maintaining as written or worth rewriting.

done_criteria.check: Does the plan name only dependencies the records still show, and does every duty it created have a future date or evidence that it was met?
